title: One Piece English Dub Kicks Off Elbaph Arc With New Crunchyroll Release
content:
Fans of the One Piece English dub release are in luck as the Elbaph Arc has finally kicked off its run with Crunchyroll with the first of its new weekly releases. One Piece returned for the Elbaph Arc earlier this year as part of a whole new era for the long running anime franchise. Rather than release new episodes of the anime on a weekly basis throughout the entire year, the production team has instead shifted One Piece to a new seasonal release schedule from now on.

With only 26 episodes a year planned for release, this change in production schedule also meant a shift in schedule for One Piece ‘s English dub as well. With One Piece: Elbaph Arc wrapping up its first season run earlier this Summer, the English dub has a clear runway for its own comeback with the start of its episodes now available to stream with Crunchyroll . New episodes will then be releasing on a weekly basis, and you can check out a sneak peek clip from the new dub release below.

One Piece: Elbaph Arc English Dub Premiere Now Streaming With Crunchyroll

Following the release of the English dub for the One Piece Heroines special last week, One Piece: Elbaph Arc ‘s own English dub release has now premiered with Episode 1156 available for streaming with Crunchyroll. New episodes of the English dub will then be releasing with Crunchyroll on a weekly basis on Tuesdays at 9AM PT for fans in the United States , Canada, Australia, New Zealand, South Africa, India, Southeast Asia, and Latin America. So there’s going to be quite a bit to enjoy through the end of the year.

This is pretty good news as the One Piece anime itself is now in the midst of its break. Following the release of its planned 26 episodes for the year, One Piece has confirmed that it will be returning for the next phase of the Elbaph Arc in 2027 . A more concrete release window or date has yet to be announced as of this time, but it will be another wave of 26 episodes for fans to enjoy when they hit next year. At least the dub release is going to help tie fans over until then.

What’s Next for the One Piece Anime?

2027 is going to be a very busy year for the One Piece anime franchise overall. Not only will it be returning for a new season of Elbaph Arc episodes, but it has also revealed that the first of two new feature film projects will be coming to theaters in Japan. One Piece Film God Valley has been revealed to be releasing in 2027 , and is teased to be adapting the God Valley Flashback that takes place within the Elbaph Arc’s events. Which does raise a lot of questions as to how the TV anime’s release schedule is going to work into that.

The One Piece is also an official remake anime series currently scheduled for a release with Netflix in February 2027. Now produced by WIT Studio, this new series is going to re-adapting the East Blue Saga from Eiichiro Oda’s original manga series and giving it a whole new lease on life. There’s also a third season of the live-action series coming to Netflix in 2027 as well, so there’s quite a lot on the way.

Are you going to be catching up with One Piece’ s English dub release? What are you excited to see from One Piece next year? Let us know all of your thoughts about it in the comments!

title: 35 Years Later, Surprise Simpsons Character Returns From a Banned Episode
content:
The Simpsons has seen a surprising character making their return after 35 long years in the newest episode, and fans never expected to see this banned character ever again. The Simpsons Season 38 has really thrown fans for a loop with one surprise after another as not only did it premiere a second Treehouse of Horror special for the year , but that special also officially reintroduced Apu Nahasapeemapetilon back into the canon after nearly a decade. But he wasn’t the only return seen in the episode either.

The Simpsons Season 38 “Treehouse of Horror Presents: The Revengening” brought Apu back into the town of Springfield with a new voice actor in tow after not speaking for nine years, but the episode went about it in a hilarious way. As Apu had a nightmare depicting where he had gone this entire time, it brought him to an island of forgotten characters and missing jokes from the history of the series. With included Leon Kompowsky, who’s last big contribution to the series was all the way back in Season 3 in 1991.

The Simpsons Acknowledges Leon After 35 Years With New Episode

Before it’s all revealed to have been a dream that Apu was having , “Treehouse of Horror Presents: The Revengening” reintroduces Apu to Springfield as a vengeful killer seeking to kill everyone in town because they all swiftly forgot he existed. He winds up washing up on an island of forgotten moments from The Simpsons past that includes landmarks like the Springfield Monorail, Marge’s Canyonaro and Ringo Starr paintings, Homer’s toilet recliner, Mr. Burns’ bear Bobo, Funzo and more. But there’s even Dr. Nick included in the mix too.

He had been seen on and off since his “death” in The Simpsons Movie 20 years ago, but he hasn’t spoken any lines on screen since Season 31 . He says that if Apu washed onto this island, it’s for a reason and addresses Leon, who quickly appears before shushing the two and moonwalks back into some bushes. Leon’s last prominent role was in the Season 3 episode, “Stark Raving Dad,” in 1991, which has been pulled from series rotation and the Disney+ streaming service since Disney bought out 20th Century Fox many years ago.

Why Did The Simpsons Ban This Episode?

“Stark Raving Dad” was pulled from streaming services not due to its content, but to the fact that it heavily uses and references late musician Michael Jackson. In 2019 when the musician was facing some severe allegations of abuse, The Simpsons producers decided to pull the episode from syndication as well as from streaming services. That still remains the case to this day, so his “shushing” and moonwalking away in the episode is further acknowledging the fact the episode and character had been swept under the rug.

The Simpsons has used Leon since this episode in other non-canon situations like this such as the Season 29 episode “Mr. Lisa’s Opus” where he’s recruited to sing Lisa another song for her birthday in 2017, but this is the first real time that he’s been acknowledged in the series since his episode had been banned. By including him with all these forgotten moments and characters like Dr. Nick , it’s a nod to the fact that the episode is still fondly remembered despite not being actively involved with Springfield anymore.

What did you think of the way The Simpsons brought back Apu, Dr. Nick and Leon? Let us know all of your thoughts about it in the comments!

title: Bleach Creator Says Goodbye to Yhwach With New Look Ahead of Anime Finale
content:
Bleach: Thousand-Year Blood War has finally put a decisive end to the anime’s final fight with the penultimate end of the series after 22 years , and the creator behind it all has shared a cool new look at Yhwach to help celebrate. Bleach: Thousand-Year Blood War – The Calamity has officially made its return to screens after a month long hiatus for its final two episodes ever. And the first of these two new episodes officially brought the fight against Yhwach to its ultimate conclusion.

Bleach: Thousand-Year Blood War – The Calamity has returned for Episode 49, the second to last episode of the long running anime franchise overall. This episode saw Ichigo and the others facing off against Yhwach across all three realms in one last ditch effort to keep the villain from fully taking over. And to help commemorate the villain’s defeat at last, series creator Tite Kubo took to social media to share a cool new look at the villain as one final goodbye.

Bleach Creator Returns With New Art of Yhwach After the Villain’s Death

Bleach: Thousand-Year Blood War – The Calamity Episode 49 picked up right after the end of that major cliffhanger before the hiatus that saw Yhwach fully invading the human world, Soul Society, and Hueco Mundo. Much like how Kubo has been expanding on the events of the manga’s final arc with new story materials and moments for the anime adaptation in the episodes thus far, the penultimate episode had extended this final fight with Yhwach in ways never seen in the original. Tons of characters were involved that had been shuffled to the side in the manga.

This led to Yhwach’s defeat across all three realms, and with Ichigo’s final strike the villain was totally defeated at the end of the episode. This means the final episode of the anime will be left to adapt the epilogue chapters from Kubo’s manga , which fans had been hoping was going to be the case. The epilogue takes place years after the final fight, and is much longer than the final moments against Yhwach. With the full finale focusing on it, it’s going to be an emotional goodbye for many fans.

When Does Bleach’ s Final Episode Come Out?

This final moment with Ichigo in action was a pretty big deal for those Bleach fans who have been waiting over 20 years for the anime to reach this point. The franchise has dropped a cool poster showing off this final look for Ichigo Kurosaki to help commemorate the moment as well, but there’s still much more to explore with the upcoming finale and new characters introduced with its time skip . It just remains to be seen whether or not the anime is going to ultimately be able to stick the landing.

As for when it finally makes its debut, the Japanese language version of Bleach: Thousand-Year Blood War – The Calamity Episode 50 will be releasing on October 26th at 8:30AM PT with Hulu and Hulu on Disney+. For those interested in the English dubbed versions of the final two episodes instead , Episode 49 will be debuting on November 23rd at 8:30AM PT followed by Episode 50 on November 30th at 8:30AM PT.

How did you like the final fight against Yhwach in Bleach: Thousand-Year Blood War ? What are you hoping to see in the final episode? Let us know all of your thoughts about it in the comments!

title: Compile Heart's Villion:Code Game Launches in West on January 26
content:
The game will get a Digital Deluxe Edition that includes a digital art book and soundtrack.

The PS5 version will have physical editions in North America and Europe, and the Switch and PS4 versions will get physical editions in North America.

The game launched in Japan on June 25 for PlayStation 4, PlayStation 5, Switch, and Switch 2.

The game's story is set in the near future where humanity is facing its approaching destruction. To find a solution to this certain doom, the "Advan Resilience Research Academy City" is established. One day, an anomaly appears in the city, which spawns strange beings known as GEM that begin attacking people, and generates a "bubble" that cuts it off from any contact or travel in or out. In this new isolated state, people begin to confront their roles as they pursue the truth of the anomaly in the academy city.

title: South Park Surprises With the Perfect JoJo’s Bizarre Adventure Shout Out – Watch
content:
South Park is no stranger to fun anime shout outs and Easter Eggs, but the latest episode really went all out to show JoJo’s Bizarre Adventure some love with some very familiar poses. South Park Season 29 has made some big changes through its three episodes so far for the year. Not only has it changed the name of the show and town to “South America ,” but it has also renewed its focus on stories about the kids. Which the latest episode showcases with a take on the current “Looksmaxxing” trends.

South Park Season 29 Episode 3 sees Ike falling into the world of Looksmaxxing and aura-farming as he “aura battles” with other kids in school. One of these battles is revealed early on as it revealed to be posing battles where the kids decide which of the two has “aura” and which of them is “cringe.” It turns out that the poses seen in this battle are actually lifted straight from Hirohiko Araki’s JoJo’s Bizarre Adventure . Check out the clip of it in action below.

South Park Season 29 Recreates Famous JoJo’s Bizarre Adventure Poses

South Park Season 29 Episode 3 is titled “You Like That on Your Face ,” and sees the kids at school obsessing over aura battles as the latest hit trend. Ike is at the center of this as he takes on all challengers, and these battles are performed with JoJo’s Bizarre Adventure poses mirror characters like Joseph Joestar, Jotaro Kujo, Josuke Higashikata, DIO and more. There are also poses from classic South Park episodes like “Faith Hilling,” so it’s all the more ridiculous as a result. Even the music behind the scene sounds a bit JoJo’s Bizarre Adventure like in nature too.

This is far from the only anime reference that South Park has had in the past, nor is it the only anime reference even seen this season. The Season 29 premiere had a great shout out to the legendary Akira anime film , but didn’t do the traditional bike slide that many other references make. Instead, it recreated a scene that was a bit more obscure by comparison and thus ended up being much more appreciated by longtime anime fans as a result. It’s the same with this JoJo’s Bizarre Adventure poses.

What’s Next for South Park Season 29?

South Park Season 29 currently has three more episodes scheduled out for the year, and they will be releasing on a bi-weekly basis. Much like every other season it’s hard to predict exactly what’s going to come in each episode before they make their premiere, but there’s a chance we’ll see more anime references and shout outs through the rest of the season. Especially now that the episodes have been focusing more of the kids and school. It’s even gotten to the point where Randy is in that mix now too .

As for JoJo’s Bizarre Adventure , it’s also airing its new episodes with Netflix as part of the Fall 2026 anime schedule. Returning to adapt the seventh iteration of Hirohiko Araki’s original manga, Steel Ball Run , this has been the version of the anime that fans of the series have been waiting quite a long time to see in action. It seems that JoJo fever has even made its way to South Park . How did you like seeing this JoJo’s Bizarre Adventure shout out in South Park ‘s newest episode? Let us know all of your thoughts about it in the comments!

title: Jujutsu Kaisen Hypes Jump Festa Update With New Look at Culling Game Roster Ahead of Season 4
content:
Jujutsu Kaisen Season 4 is currently in the works, but fans might get an update sooner than expected. Based on a Weekly Shonen Jump manga written and illustrated by Gege Akutami, the anime adaptation by MAPPA is one of the most successful shows of all time. Season 3 was released this year, which only featured the first half of the Culling Game. Along with following the aftermath of the Shibuya Incident Arc, the anime sheds more light on Kenjaku’s true goal as he orchestrates the Culling Game. While fans await the anime’s return, the official X handle of AMNIBUS shared a new visual for this year’s Jump Festa.

The visual features chibi art styles of Yuji, Megumi, and many other major characters from the Culling Game Arc. This also includes the new characters, Fumihiko Takaba and Hiromi Higuruma. While Naoya Zenin is often included among the Culling Game characters, his role extends to the aftermath of the Shibuya Incident in the anime. The update was shared along with several other Jump Festa updates as the date of the convention draws near. The official X handle also confirmed there will be more updates during the event, although the panel that AMNIBUS is holding will be primarily limited to merchandise.

Jujutsu Kaisen Season 4 Will Drop New Information During Jump Festa

While the update from AMNIBUS is limited to merchandise, fans can expect updates on Season 4 as well. The official website has already confirmed that Jujutsu Kaisen will be holding a panel during this year’s Jump Festa, which will be held on December 19th and 20th, 2026. Jump Festa is the largest annual convention held by Shueisha, since it focuses on new announcements for anime, manga, and games, interactive exhibits, and unique merchandise that is often available only at the convention. The fourth season dropped a teaser in June this year during MAPPA’s 15th anniversary event. However, fans can expect more updates during the event, especially a key visual, another teaser, or even a release window if we’re lucky. Since the third season was only 12 episodes long, the upcoming season will drop earlier than usual to wrap up the longest arc in the manga.

What to Expect From Jujutsu Kaisen Season 4

The fourth season will be the most intense part of the story where fans will witness several more battles and plot twists. Although Gojo’s students have already figured out a way to free him from the Prison Realm, it’s not really an easy task considering all the obstacles Kenjaku has put in front of them. The third season ended with Yuta Okkotsu displaying why he’s second only to Satoru Gojo. However, after his thrilling battle in Sendai, the story will move on to other characters like Hakari and Kashimo, who will get their chance to shine in the fourth season. Furthermore, the arc will also feature a major plot twist that will change the story forever. The Culling Game is the second final arc of the manga, which ends on a cliffhanger before the final battle continues in the Shinjuku Showdown Arc.

The fourth season will be the most intense part of the story where fans will witness several more battles and plot twists. Although Gojo’s students have already figured out a way to free him from the Prison Realm, it’s not really an easy task considering all the obstacles Kenjaku has put in front of them. The third season ended with Yuta Okkotsu displaying why he’s second only to Satoru Gojo. However, after his thrilling battle in Sendai, the story will move on to other characters like Hakari and Kashimo, who will get their chance to shine in the fourth season. Furthermore, the arc will also feature a major plot twist that will change the story forever. The Culling Game is the second final arc of the manga, which ends on a cliffhanger before the final battle continues in the Shinjuku Showdown Arc.

title: Pandora Hearts Manga Gets 3rd Stage Musical
content:
Jun Mochizuki 's Pandora Hearts manga is inspiring a third stage musical adaptation titled PandoraHearts Retrace III -Reverse corte- that will run at Theater H in Tokyo on September 17-26, 2027 and at Sankei Hall Breeze in Osaka on October 2-3, 2027. The staff streamed a trailer, but it is not available in the U.S.

Akira Yamazaki returns to direct and write the script, with Ako Takahashi writing lyrics, and Harumi Fuuki composing the music. Kazan Yokoyama is returning to play Oz Vessalius.

The first stage musical ran in Tokyo's Theater H in November 2025.

Mochizuki launched Pandora Hearts in Square Enix 's Monthly G Fantasy magazine in 2006, and the manga ended in 2015 with 24 compiled book volumes.

Yen Press licensed Mochizuki's Pandora Hearts and Crimson-Shell manga , as well as Shinobu Wakamiya 's side story novel Pandora Hearts: Caucus Race , for North America. NIS America released the 25-episode anime adaptation by Xebec , which premiered in 2009.

Yen Press released the manga in English, and describes the manga's story:

The air of celebration surrounding fifteen-year-old Oz Vessalius's coming-of-age ceremony quickly turns to horror when he is condemned for a sin about which he knows nothing. He is thrown into an eternal, inescapable prison known as the Abyss from which there is no escape. There, he meets a young girl named Alice, who is not what she seems. Now that the relentless cogs of fate have begun to turn, do they lead only to crushing despair for Oz, or is there some shred of hope for him to grasp on to?

Mochizuki launched the The Case Study of Vanitas ( Vanitas no Carte ) manga in Square Enix 's Gangan Joker magazine in December 2015. Square Enix published the 11th volume in April 2024. Yen Press has been publishing the manga simultaneously in English since its debut. BONES ' television anime of the manga premiered in July 2021. The anime's second part premiered in January 2022. Funimation streamed the first part, and it also streamed an English dub . Both Funimation and Crunchyroll streamed the second part as it aired, and Crunchyroll also added the first part.

title: Major Netflix Anime Teases Surprise Finale With New Trailer for October 2026 Return – Watch
content:
A major anime series is coming back to Netflix for special new episodes later this month, and it turns out to be teasing a surprise finale with a new trailer and poster hyping up its debut. The Fall 2026 anime schedule has seen a lot of franchises returning with brand new episodes , but some of these returns have been more surprising than others. That’s going to be especially the case for the anime adaptation of Akumi Agitogi and Tsukiho Tsukioka’s My Happy Marriage light novel series. Which just might fully be ending.

My Happy Marriage has been a monster streaming hit with Netflix ever since the anime made its debut back in 2023, and continued with that success in its second season last year . But following the end of that season, it was announced that it would only be returning next with a small batch of special episodes. As teased by the official social media account for the anime series, this might just actually be the finale. You can check out the new trailer for My Happy Marriage – Special Episodes below.

My Happy Marriage Teases Finale With New Netflix Episodes

My Happy Marriage – Special Episodes will be making their worldwide debut with Netflix on October 25th , and will be including three special episodes that have not been seen thus far. There is going to be a returning production staff from the main TV series with Takehiro Kubota directing for Kinema Citrus, Mika Tanaka and Ikuho Negi providing the scripts, Shoko Yasuda, Hikaru Sato, and Kuniyuki Ito providing the character designs, and Evan Call composing the music. There’s also a new ending theme titled “Just before the Prelude 〜for me&you〜” as performed by Kashitaro Ito.

Reina Ueda as Miyo Saimori and Kaito Ishikawa as Kiyoka Kudo will also be returning to headline the Japanese voice cast for the new special episodes , but a potential English dub release has yet to be confirmed by Netflix as of this time. They tease what to expect from these new episodes as such, “As Miyo and Kiyoka prepare for their wedding, the appearance of a figure from Miyo’s past will throw everything off balance.” But the most curious element of it all is the tease of a potential “finale.”

Is My Happy Marriage’s Anime Going to End?

The official social media for My Happy Marriage released a special new poster for the upcoming special episodes (which you can see above), and labeled it as a “Finale Visual” as it parallels some of the first looks we got at the original TV anime series three years ago. With the original light novel series still releasing new editions in Japan, it’s not quite clear if this will actually be the grand finale for the anime adaptation. But it’s certainly surprising to fans to find out in such a way if that’s the case.

The potential anime future beyond the release of these special episodes has yet to be revealed, but we’ll likely get an update on a possible continuation sometime after the official release of these special episodes. But if My Happy Marriage releases these episodes with no potential word on anything more, fans might have to brace themselves for the end.

Do you think this is the end of the My Happy Marriage anime? Do you think this could be a good place to end? Let us know all of your thoughts about it in the comments!

title: 'Shingeki no Kyojin' Voice Actor Hiroshi Tsuchida Dies at 54
content:
Voice actor Hiroshi Tsuchida , best known for Grisha Yeager in Shingeki no Kyojin ( Attack on Titan ) and Daikichi Kawachi in Usagi Drop ( Bunny Drop ), died on October 11 of heart failure. He was 54.

His agency, 81 Produce , announced the news on Tuesday, noting that the funeral was held privately for family members only, at the family’s request.

Born in Tokyo in February 1972, Tsuchida graduated from Tokyo Metropolitan Bunkyo High School and trained for two years with the Touhai theater company. After an injury made him consider quitting, he joined the talent agency Big Apple. He made his acting debut in 1994 as Saizo (Ninja Blue) in Ninja Sentai Kakuranger , then worked mainly as a voice actor and narrator from the late 1990s. He also voiced HANE2 in Ultraman Decker .

• Over the course of his career, Tsuchida voiced many memorable characters, including Keigo Oonishi in Texhnolyze , Ganesha in Dungeon ni Deai wo Motomeru no wa Machigatteiru Darou ka ( Is It Wrong to Try to Pick Up Girls in a Dungeon? ), John Titor in Steins;Gate , Raidou Namiashi in Naruto , and his most recent role, Timothy Britts in Mushoku Tensei III: Isekai Ittara Honki Dasu ( Mushoku Tensei: Jobless Reincarnation Season 3 ).

Outside anime, he also voiced Feng Wei in the Tekken game series and Kazuki in the Yakuza games. In Japanese dubbing, he voiced Joseph Gordon-Levitt and Scott Adkins in many of their films, as well as Lightning McQueen in the Cars films, Kraglin in the Guardians of the Galaxy series, and Donatello in the Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles (2012) television series.

title: Hiroshi Tsuchida, Attack on Titan & Super Sentai Star, Dies at 54
content:
Hiroshi Tsuchida, star of Ninja Sentai Kakuranger, Attack on Titan, Pokémon and more has sadly died at the age of 54 as announced by talent agency 81 Produce . The talent agency shared an official statement this morning revealing that Tsuchida had died on October 11th due to heart failure, and had a private funeral service attended by family as per the family’s wishes, “We express our deepest gratitude for the kindness and support he received during his lifetime and respectfully announce his passing.”

Born on February 8, 1972, Tsuchida’s acting crosses multiple mediums that many fans are likely to recognize. Not only had he provided voice acting performances for notable anime franchises such as Attack on Titan , but also was often a key member of the Japanese dubbing cast for major feature film releases like Disney/Pixar’s Cars franchise as Lightning McQueen. The star even had a stint as a member of the Super Sentai team, Ninja Sentai Kakuranger in 1994.

RIP Hiroshi Tsuchida (1972-2026)

Hiroshi Tsuchida had a long and storied career across live-action, anime, and feature film projects. His stint in Ninja Sentai Kakuranger saw him taking on the role Saizo, otherwise known as Ninja Blue. Having many notable moments through his time with the franchise (even returning to reprise the role for special anniversary projects years later), fans will probably most recognize him as one of the key faces behind the “Today is Friday in California!” meme when an assassin attempts to take him out. So even if you didn’t immediately realize it, you’re aware of Tsuchida’s work.

As for his work in the world of anime, Tsuchida has been a part of some key franchises. Notably starring as the voice of Eren’s father Grisha Yeager in Attack on Titan , Professor Sycamore in Pokemon: XY, Ganesha in Is It Wrong to Pick Up Girls in a Dungeon? , Asakura in Sakamoto Days , and most recently Damnatio in Black Clover . He could be heard in the most recent episode of the series (which comes five years after the first season) as he helped the Wizard King fight back against a massive demonic enemy attacking the Clover Kingdom.

Tsuchida was also a key player in Japanese dubs for Hollywood feature film releases. He’s provided the dub for notable actors like Joseph-Gordon Levitt for films such as The Dark Knight Rises and Inception , Scott Adkins in Accident Man , and Sean Gunn in the Guardians of the Galaxy franchise and Thor: Love and Thunder . He also dubbed over characters such as Rick Grimes in The Walking Dead franchise, Lightning McQueen in the Cars franchise, Gwi-Ma in KPop Demon Hunters , Dr. Nefario in Minions: The Rise of Gru and more.

Such a long and storied career across multiple mediums, genres, and projects means that you’ve likely seen and enjoyed one of Tsuchida’s performances even if you didn’t immediately recognize it. Which goes to show how much of an absence there will be felt now, and ComicBook extends our condolences to Hiroshi Tsuchida’s family, friends and loved ones at this time.
